title: Venezuelan Beef Empanadas
description: A traditional Venezuelan dish, empanadas are savory pastries filled with seasoned ground beef and onions, fried to a crispy golden brown.
instructions: Preheat oil in a deep frying pan to 375°F (190°C).
Roll out the empanada dough to 1/8 inch thickness.
Cut out circles of dough using a cookie cutter or the rim of a glass.
Place a tablespoon of beef mixture in the center of each dough circle.
Fold the dough in half to form a half-moon shape, pressing edges to seal.
Brush the tops with beaten egg for a golden glaze.
Heat the oil in a deep frying pan to 375°F (190°C).
Fry empanadas until golden brown, about 2-3 minutes on each side.
Drain on paper towels and serve hot.
